title: Answer Context Drill-Down QA
principle: Answer audit must lead to simple correction: users can open the exact context controls behind a response without secrets, spend or backend setup.
public_repo_rule: Drill-down actions only open existing public-safe panels. They do not store provider keys, send prompts, start paid routes or mutate backend state.

scenarios.label: Memory
scenarios.expected: Open local memory governance from the answer receipt.

scenarios.label: Knowledge
scenarios.expected: Open local knowledge/RAG controls from the answer receipt.

scenarios.label: Model
scenarios.expected: Open free model library and route choices from the answer receipt.

scenarios.label: Privacy
scenarios.expected: Open export/delete/privacy inventory controls from the answer receipt.
